WITH campsite_stats AS (
  SELECT
    cs.campground_id,
    count(*) AS campsite_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE cs.reservation_url IS NOT NULL) AS campsites_with_reservation_url,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE cs.schedule <> '{}'::jsonb) AS campsites_with_schedule,
    string_agg(DISTINCT cs.data_source, ', ' ORDER BY cs.data_source) AS campsite_sources,
    string_agg(DISTINCT cs.kind, ', ' ORDER BY cs.kind) AS campsite_kinds
  FROM campsites cs
  WHERE cs.deleted_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY cs.campground_id
), availability_stats AS (
  SELECT
    cs.campground_id,
    max(a.last_observed_at) AS latest_availability_observed_at,
    count(a.id) AS availability_snapshot_rows
  FROM campsites cs
  JOIN availability a ON a.campsite_id = cs.id
  WHERE cs.deleted_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY cs.campground_id
), poller_stats AS (
  SELECT
    poi_id,
    string_agg(provider || ':' || CASE WHEN active THEN 'active' ELSE 'inactive' END, ', ' ORDER BY provider) AS availability_pollers,
    bool_or(active) AS has_active_poller,
    max(last_run_at) AS latest_poller_run_at,
    min(next_run_at) FILTER (WHERE active) AS next_poller_run_at
  FROM availability_poller
  GROUP BY poi_id
), canonical_pois AS (
  SELECT
    p.id AS poi_id,
    p.poi_type,
    COALESCE(cg.name, ts.common_site_name, pf.name) AS name,
    COALESCE(cg.location->>'region', ts.region, pf.region) AS region,
    COALESCE(cg.location->>'country', ts.country::text, pf.country::text) AS country,
    ST_X(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lng,
    ST_Y(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lat,
    pc.campground_id,
    pts.tesla_supercharger_id,
    ppf.planet_fitness_location_id,
    cg.data_source,
    cg.status AS campground_status,
    cg.reservation_url,
    substring(cg.reservation_url from '^https?://([^/]+)') AS booking_site,
    primary_vr.vendor AS primary_vendor,
    primary_vr.external_id AS primary_vendor_ref_id,
    primary_vr.source_url AS primary_vendor_source_url,
    provider_ref.availability_provider_ref,
    COALESCE(campsite_stats.campsite_count, 0) AS campsite_count,
    campsite_stats.campsite_sources,
    campsite_stats.campsite_kinds,
    campsite_stats.campsites_with_reservation_url,
    campsite_stats.campsites_with_schedule,
    (cg.metadata->>'has_availability_data' = 'true') AS metadata_has_availability_data,
    (cg.metadata->>'has_campsite_level_data' = 'true') AS metadata_has_campsite_level_data,
    NULLIF(concat_ws(', ',
      CASE WHEN provider_ref.availability_provider_ref IS NOT NULL THEN 'provider_ref:' || provider_ref.availability_provider_ref END,
      CASE WHEN cg.reservation_url IS NOT NULL THEN 'reservation_url' END,
      CASE WHEN cg.metadata->>'has_availability_data' = 'true' THEN 'availability_data' END,
      CASE WHEN cg.metadata->>'has_campsite_level_data' = 'true' THEN 'campsite_level_data' END,
      CASE WHEN cg.default_campsite_schedule <> '{}'::jsonb THEN 'default_schedule' END,
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(campsite_stats.campsites_with_reservation_url, 0) > 0 THEN 'site_reserve_urls:' || campsite_stats.campsites_with_reservation_url::text END,
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(campsite_stats.campsites_with_schedule, 0) > 0 THEN 'site_schedules:' || campsite_stats.campsites_with_schedule::text END
    ), '') AS booking_capabilities,
    poller_stats.availability_pollers,
    poller_stats.has_active_poller,
    poller_stats.latest_poller_run_at,
    poller_stats.next_poller_run_at,
    availability_stats.latest_availability_observed_at,
    availability_stats.availability_snapshot_rows,
    ts.site_status AS tesla_site_status,
    ts.stall_count,
    ts.max_power_kw
  FROM pois p
  LEFT JOIN poi_campgrounds pc ON pc.poi_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN campgrounds cg ON cg.id = pc.campground_id AND cg.deleted_at IS NULL
  LEFT JOIN vendor_refs primary_vr ON primary_vr.id = cg.primary_vendor_ref_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN primary_vr.payload ? 'recgov_id' THEN 'recgov'
      WHEN primary_vr.payload ? 'campflare_id' THEN 'campflare'
      WHEN primary_vr.payload ? 'mapId' AND primary_vr.payload ? 'transactionLocationId' THEN 'aspira'
      WHEN primary_vr.payload ? 'park_id' OR primary_vr.payload ? 'facility_id' THEN 'reserveamerica'
      WHEN primary_vr.payload ? 'place_id' AND primary_vr.payload ? 'facility_ids' THEN 'reservecalifornia'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS availability_provider_ref
  ) provider_ref ON true
  LEFT JOIN campsite_stats ON campsite_stats.campground_id = cg.id
  LEFT JOIN availability_stats ON availability_stats.campground_id = cg.id
  LEFT JOIN poller_stats ON poller_stats.poi_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN poi_tesla_superchargers pts ON pts.poi_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN tesla_superchargers ts ON ts.id = pts.tesla_supercharger_id AND ts.deleted_at IS NULL
  LEFT JOIN poi_planet_fitness_locations ppf ON ppf.poi_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN planet_fitness_locations pf ON pf.id = ppf.planet_fitness_location_id AND pf.deleted_at IS NULL
  WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
)
SELECT *
FROM canonical_pois
WHERE (btrim(COALESCE((ARRAY[${poi_name:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '')) = '' OR COALESCE(name, '') ILIKE '%' || btrim(COALESCE((ARRAY[${poi_name:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '')) || '%')
  AND CASE
    WHEN COALESCE((ARRAY[${poi_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') IN ('', '__all_pois', '__all_campgrounds') THEN true
    WHEN COALESCE((ARRAY[${poi_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN poi_id::text = COALESCE((ARRAY[${poi_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '')
    ELSE false
  END
  AND (COALESCE((ARRAY[${poi_type:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') IN ('', '__all', '$__all') OR poi_type IN (COALESCE((ARRAY[${poi_type:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '')))
ORDER BY name ASC NULLS LAST, poi_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  cs.id AS campsite_id,
  cs.data_source,
  cs.campground_id,
  cg.name AS campground_name,
  cg.data_source AS campground_data_source,
  cs.loop_name,
  cs.name,
  cs.kind,
  cs.kind_listed,
  cs.max_people,
  cs.max_rv_length,
  cs.max_trailer_length,
  cs.reservation_url,
  (cs.schedule <> '{}'::jsonb) AS has_schedule,
  cs.electric_hookups,
  cs.water_hookups,
  cs.sewer_hookups,
  cs.ada_accessible,
  cs.pull_through,
  primary_vr.vendor AS primary_vendor,
  primary_vr.external_id AS primary_vendor_ref_id,
  provider_ref.availability_provider_ref,
  NULLIF(concat_ws(', ',
    CASE WHEN provider_ref.availability_provider_ref IS NOT NULL THEN 'provider_ref:' || provider_ref.availability_provider_ref END,
    CASE WHEN cs.reservation_url IS NOT NULL THEN 'reservation_url' END,
    CASE WHEN cs.schedule <> '{}'::jsonb THEN 'schedule' END,
    CASE WHEN cs.electric_hookups IS TRUE THEN 'electric' END,
    CASE WHEN cs.water_hookups IS TRUE THEN 'water' END,
    CASE WHEN cs.sewer_hookups IS TRUE THEN 'sewer' END,
    CASE WHEN cs.pull_through IS TRUE THEN 'pull_through' END
  ), '') AS booking_capabilities,
  max(a.last_observed_at) AS latest_availability_observed_at,
  count(a.id) AS availability_snapshot_rows,
  bool_or(a.status = 'available') FILTER (WHERE a.last_observed_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS any_available_last_7d
FROM poi_campgrounds pc
JOIN campgrounds cg ON cg.id = pc.campground_id
JOIN campsites cs ON cs.campground_id = cg.id AND cs.deleted_at IS NULL
LEFT JOIN vendor_refs primary_vr ON primary_vr.id = cs.primary_vendor_ref_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT CASE
      WHEN primary_vr.payload ? 'recgov_id' THEN 'recgov'
      WHEN primary_vr.payload ? 'campflare_id' THEN 'campflare'
      WHEN primary_vr.payload ? 'mapId' AND primary_vr.payload ? 'transactionLocationId' THEN 'aspira'
      WHEN primary_vr.payload ? 'park_id' OR primary_vr.payload ? 'facility_id' THEN 'reserveamerica'
      WHEN primary_vr.payload ? 'place_id' AND primary_vr.payload ? 'facility_ids' THEN 'reservecalifornia'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS availability_provider_ref
) provider_ref ON true
LEFT JOIN availability a ON a.campsite_id = cs.id
WHERE COALESCE((ARRAY[${poi_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND pc.poi_id::text = COALESCE((ARRAY[${poi_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '')
GROUP BY cs.id, cg.id, primary_vr.id, provider_ref.availability_provider_ref
ORDER BY cs.loop_name NULLS LAST, cs.name NULLS LAST, cs.id ASC;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT NULLIF(COALESCE((ARRAY[${target_date:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], ''), '')::date AS target_date
), observations AS (
  SELECT
    s.last_observed_at,
    s.status::text AS status,
    lag(s.last_observed_at) OVER (ORDER BY s.last_observed_at, s.id) AS observed_from
  FROM availability s
  JOIN target ON target.target_date = s.target_date
  WHERE COALESCE((ARRAY[${campsite_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
    AND s.campsite_id::text = COALESCE((ARRAY[${campsite_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '')
), bounds AS (
  SELECT
    min(last_observed_at) AS first_observed_at,
    least((target.target_date + interval '1 day')::timestamptz, now()) AS last_axis_at
  FROM observations
  CROSS JOIN target
  GROUP BY target.target_date
)
SELECT
  o.last_observed_at AS time,
  o.status AS metric,
  CASE o.status
    WHEN 'available' THEN 4
    WHEN 'first_come' THEN 3
    WHEN 'reserved' THEN 2
    WHEN 'booked' THEN 1
    WHEN 'closed' THEN 0
    ELSE -1
  END::double precision AS value,
  b.first_observed_at,
  b.last_axis_at
FROM observations o
CROSS JOIN bounds b
ORDER BY o.last_observed_at ASC;

WITH selected_campsites AS (
  SELECT cs.id AS campsite_id, cs.loop_name, cs.name
  FROM poi_campgrounds pc
  JOIN campsites cs ON cs.campground_id = pc.campground_id AND cs.deleted_at IS NULL
  WHERE COALESCE((ARRAY[${poi_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
    AND pc.poi_id::text = COALESCE((ARRAY[${poi_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '')
), target_dates AS (
  SELECT generate_series(current_date, current_date + interval '29 days', interval '1 day')::date AS target_date
), latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.campsite_id, s.target_date)
    s.campsite_id,
    s.target_date,
    s.status::text AS status
  FROM availability s
  JOIN selected_campsites sc ON sc.campsite_id = s.campsite_id
  ORDER BY s.campsite_id, s.target_date, s.last_observed_at DESC, s.id DESC
)
SELECT
  sc.campsite_id,
  coalesce(sc.loop_name || ' / ', '') || sc.name AS "site / day",
  to_char(d.target_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS target_date,
  coalesce(l.status, 'unknown') AS status_key
FROM selected_campsites sc
CROSS JOIN target_dates d
LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.campsite_id = sc.campsite_id AND l.target_date = d.target_date
WHERE (COALESCE((ARRAY[${loop_name:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') = '' OR sc.loop_name = COALESCE((ARRAY[${loop_name:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], ''))
ORDER BY sc.loop_name NULLS LAST, sc.name NULLS LAST, d.target_date ASC;

WITH filters AS (
  SELECT btrim(COALESCE((ARRAY[${poi_name:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '')) AS name_filter
), site_counts AS (
  SELECT campground_id, count(*) AS campsite_count
  FROM campsites
  WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY campground_id
)
SELECT __text, __value
FROM (
  SELECT 0 AS sort_key, 'All campgrounds / use filters' AS __text, '__all_campgrounds' AS __value
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    1 AS sort_key,
    p.id::text || ' | ' || cg.name || ' | ' || cg.data_source || ' | ' || COALESCE(site_counts.campsite_count, 0)::text || ' sites' || COALESCE(' | ' || primary_vr.external_id, '') AS __text,
    p.id::text AS __value
  FROM pois p
  JOIN poi_campgrounds pc ON pc.poi_id = p.id
  JOIN campgrounds cg ON cg.id = pc.campground_id AND cg.deleted_at IS NULL
  LEFT JOIN vendor_refs primary_vr ON primary_vr.id = cg.primary_vendor_ref_id
  LEFT JOIN site_counts ON site_counts.campground_id = cg.id
  CROSS JOIN filters
  WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND p.poi_type = 'campground'
    AND (
      filters.name_filter = ''
      OR p.id::text = filters.name_filter
      OR cg.name ILIKE '%' || filters.name_filter || '%'
      OR cg.data_source ILIKE '%' || filters.name_filter || '%'
      OR COALESCE(primary_vr.external_id, '') ILIKE '%' || filters.name_filter || '%'
    )
) options
ORDER BY sort_key, __text
LIMIT 501

WITH filters AS (
  SELECT
    btrim(COALESCE((ARRAY[${poi_name:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '')) AS name_filter,
    COALESCE((ARRAY[${poi_id:sqlstring}]::text[])[1], '') AS poi_filter
)
SELECT __text, __value
FROM (
  SELECT 0 AS sort_key, 'No campsite selected' AS __text, '__no_campsite' AS __value
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    1 AS sort_key,
    cs.id::text || ' | ' || cg.name || ' / ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(cs.loop_name, '') || ' / ', '') || cs.name || ' | ' || cs.data_source AS __text,
    cs.id::text AS __value
  FROM campsites cs
  JOIN campgrounds cg ON cg.id = cs.campground_id
  LEFT JOIN poi_campgrounds pc ON pc.campground_id = cg.id
  CROSS JOIN filters
  WHERE cs.deleted_at IS NULL
